hero.description: Describe what you need. AI generates concepts, renders images grounded in your real products, and scores each variant across 6 quality dimensions. Deploy the winners.

body: The creative pipeline is deterministic: campaign context in, scored creatives out. AI generates concepts grounded in your real product photos, logos, and proof assets — not generic stock. Every variant is scored across six dimensions: product fidelity, brand fidelity, readability, authenticity, placement fit, and policy safety. Track every generated creative from creation to deployment to click to conversion. Know exactly which visual angles drive revenue.
scoringCaption: Each variant scored on: product fidelity, brand fidelity, readability, authenticity, placement fit, and policy safety.

benefits.title: Grounded in your brand
benefits.desc: AI references your real product photos, logos, and proof assets. Not generic stock — images that look like your actual business.

benefits.title: 4 channels, one brief
benefits.desc: Meta ads, social posts, website sections, and presentation slides — all generated from a single campaign brief. Resized and formatted per platform.

benefits.title: Explore mode
benefits.desc: Found a winner? Explore mode generates 10+ variations of your best concept for A/B testing. Find the exact angle that converts.

scenario: You're launching a spring HVAC promotion. Type: "Generate creatives for our spring AC tune-up special — $99 for existing customers." HABOS pulls your AC service photos, brand colors, and the campaign offer. In 90 seconds: 3 concepts, 12 variants across Meta, Instagram, and your website. The top-scoring variant has a 9.1 quality rating. Click "Deploy" — it's live on Meta and published to your website's campaign surface.

cta.heading: Other tools generate generic images. HABOS generates scored, brand-ready campaigns.
